title: ACI 318, Section 21.
officialText:
12.1.1. Modify ACI 318, Section 21.12.1.1, to read as follows:

21.12.1.1 Foundations resisting earthquake-induced forces or transferring earthquake-induced forces between a structure and the ground shall comply with the requirements of Section 21.10 and other applicable provisions of ACI 318 unless modified by
Chapter 18 of the New York City Building Code.
